audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits 50.76% over 262 games: Brand's 900/1050 poke wins the windows between Aurora's hops, and Between Worlds plus Spirit Abjuration healing turn the mid-game over to her.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer rows read 'Skill' while the content layer and the packet both read Brand 0-3 / Aurora 4-6, and the full-layer whys for rows 4-6 described Brand winning.
audit.why: Across the Veil is 22s at rank 1, so before 6 Brand's poke owns her downtime windows. From 6, Between Worlds leaps her in, slows an area and lets her teleport across it on 140s at rank 1, and her passive heals off every spell she lands — she picks the fights from there.
audit.corrected: Full rows 0-3 -> Brand, rows 4-6 -> Aurora, whys for 4-6 rewritten to match. Content win[0..6] already carries these values, so no paired win[N] edit exists. One atomic chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three factual errors about Aurora's kit, plus a digit-free cooldowns field. The page said she has NO DASH ('Her lack of a dash', 'while she has no dash-and-stealth escape'), called her Q 'melee-range', attributed the STEALTH to Between Worlds (R), and gave Twofold Hex a slow it does not have.
audit.why: Across the Veil (W) is the leap that grants invisibility and move speed — she has it from early levels, on 22s at rank 1. Twofold Hex (Q) is a 900-range missile that curses and is recast to pull the curses back; it has no slow. The Weirding (E) is the 825-range slow that also hops her backward. Between Worlds (R) leaps, slows a zone and lets her teleport across that zone — no invisibility. Spirit Abjuration (P) heals her off the spirits she exorcises, which is why chip poke without Grievous Wounds feeds her.
audit.corrected: Every one of those replaced with the real ability, range and cooldown across whys, spikes, early/mid/late and wants; anti-heal timing written into breakdown.carry, dontsFull[2].d and whys[6].
